safe_title: An Equivariant-Zeta Audit of Cat-Map Centralizer Quotients
paper_role: scoped low-novelty boundary audit of whether standard equivariant, orbifold, and quotient-stack refinements repair Paper 10's coarse clock collapse
positioning: standard refinements form a definition-sensitive information-loss hierarchy: point-order Burnside data retain source order, orbit-order Burnside data retain a static orbit type, stronger G-permutation and enhanced carriers retain the labelled effective twist, and orbifold or Morita quotient outputs compress to static data; none creates a common modulus or prime clock

preserved_review_history.sole_blocker: the v1 research question incorrectly called Phi a Burnside-ring homomorphism
preserved_review_history.v2_disposition: repaired by defining Phi only as an additive map on Lefschetz or exact-period classes, proving nonmultiplicativity on the regular orbit, and preserving exponentwise reductions

upstream_paper9_bindings.use_boundary: Paper 9 supplies only terminal prime-shell context; no code, result, candidate, or arithmetic datum is rerun or enlarged

upstream_paper10_bindings.decisive_inherited_result: G_q=Cent_GL2(Z/qZ)(A)=R_q[A]^times is finite abelian, CV_q is its free transitive torsor, A acts by internal translation, and CV_q/G_q is one fixed point for every q>=2
upstream_paper10_bindings.use_boundary: Paper 11 starts from the frozen terminal theorem and nine-row ledger only; it neither alters nor reruns Paper 10

independent_design_inputs.blind_math_novelty_checkpoint: SAFE_SCOPED_HIERARCHY: point-order Burnside data depend only on <a>; orbit-order and quotient/inertia dynamics are static; the C x Z invariant recovers exactly a modulo the action kernel; C6/C2 disjoint-union C6/C3 is effective but has no period-6 factor
independent_design_inputs.blind_novelty_checkpoint: LOW_NOVELTY_2_OF_10: direct 2008, 2013, 2015, and 2018 prior art; only the exact Paper-10 retention-compression specialization is defensible
independent_design_inputs.definition_checkpoint: the 2008 fixed-point rational Burnside zeta, 2015 fixed-orbit integral Burnside zeta, and 2013 G-permutation invariant are three different constructions
independent_design_inputs.independence_boundary: the v1 review is immutable repair history and does not authorize implementation; a fresh reviewer must bind the complete v2 hashes before any code or execution

novelty_lock.safe_delta: a proof-complete definition-separated retention-compression ledger on the exact Paper-10 regular centralizer torsor, including action-kernel recovery, static inertia, period collisions, composites, and the effective C6 counterexample

formal_convention_lock.ordinary_zeta_sign: Artin-Mazur inverse convention: a cycle of length d contributes (1-t^d)^(-1)
formal_convention_lock.enhanced_name: 2018 enhanced Burnside class and enhanced orbifold zeta
formal_convention_lock.scalar_reduction_definition: for additive psi, psi_*(product_m (1-t^m)^(-s_m/m)) is product_m (1-t^m)^(-psi(s_m)/m)
formal_convention_lock.orbifold_map_type: additive homomorphism of abelian groups on Burnside classes; not a ring homomorphism for Cartesian multiplication
formal_convention_lock.orbifold_map_nonmultiplicativity_witness: for regular u=[G/1] with nontrivial G, u^2=|G|u, Phi(u)=1, Phi(u^2)=|G|, and Phi(u)^2=1
formal_convention_lock.power_structure_guard: no claim is made that arbitrary Burnside marks, cardinality, or the additive orbifold map preserve Burnside multiplication, the pre-lambda structure, or the symmetric-power structure; reductions are formed from exact-period exponent classes

general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.input: finite abelian C, a in C, H=<a>, X=disjoint_union over K of n_K copies of C/K
general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.point_information_boundary: depends on a only through H=<a> and cannot distinguish generators of H
general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.g_permutation_recovery: exactly a modulo N; exact labelled a iff the C-action is effective
general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.quotient_stack: [X/C] is equivalent to the disjoint union of n_K copies of BK
general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.stack_dynamics: translation by a is 2-isomorphic to identity; all retained inertia is static
general_finite_abelian_theorem_lock.scope: this theorem is elementary within established constructions and is not claimed as a new equivariant-zeta theory

paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.point_lefschetz: L^(G_q)(phi_q^k)=u_q iff r_q divides k, otherwise 0
paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.four_reduction_tradeoff: no audited scalar reduction has both source support r_q and unit exponent
paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.action_groupoid: G_q action_groupoid X_q is equivalent to one point
paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.inertia: only the identity sector is nonempty
paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.induced_endofunctor: naturally isomorphic to identity via arrows labelled a_q
paper10_torsor_specialization_lock.coefficient_category_boundary: B(G_q), K0(finite G_q-permutations), and enhanced B(G_q) vary with q and no canonical cross-q comparison is supplied
